The workflows on this PR are showing as `action_required` and haven't started, so there are no green checks yet — same fork-approval gate that has held my #22683/#22684/#22685 since 14 August. A maintainer pressing "Approve and run workflows" would unblock it.

Local run against current `main` (`eval_utils.py` is untouched upstream):

```
$ pytest tests/evaluation -q
54 passed
$ pytest tests/evaluation/test_eval_utils.py -q
7 passed
```

The three new parametrizations fail on `main` (score-only input raises `ValueError`, leading-blank-line input returns `None`) and pass with the change.
